correctness.rationale: Equation (1) is justified by monotone paths with nonoverlapping shortcuts; two permitted shortcuts saturate Z/3Z, so the complete between-level incidence table is sign-independent. The three fixed-coordinate chains and three-element antichain give exact width three. A direct structural induction on \(C^2\) formulae from equal atomic-pair counts establishes logical equivalence. Distinct lower-degree levels plus identity adjacent matchings force a single affine coordinate permutation, leading exactly to global sign reversal. This gives \(2^{t-1}\) distinct types; C3 translation orbits coincide with first-round colour classes. Two executed standard-library checks tested 254 constructions and 407,646 relation entries as corroboration, not infinite proof.
